measurement_limits: Arithmetic returned-sample means and conditional positive-sample means are not wall-time utilization averages.
HMX/HVX percentages are observed SDK active/load ratios, not physical tile occupancy or total NPU utilization.
Counter statistics include initialization, prefill, decode, and any observed idle time; SDK source-clock conversion is unresolved.
Receipt-gap statistics include callback batching and are not an independent hardware sampling-cadence measurement.
Fixed-prompt greedy token equality does not establish matched probabilities/logits or general model accuracy.
One sequential run per case; thermal/order effects remain possible and no confidence interval is estimated.
First generated token uses prefill logits; aggregate output throughput includes sampling and excludes prefill elapsed time.
Submitted decode width alone does not prove useful HMX physical-row occupancy; separate traces are required.
